等同 Python break：只退出包住它的最近一层循环，不停止整个脚本。循环: Like Python break: exits only the nearest enclosing loop, not the whole script. That loop's else branch is skipped.
等同 Python continue：跳过当前循环本轮剩余动作，从下一轮继续；不: Like Python continue: skips the remaining actions in the current iteration and continues with the next. Outer loops are unaffected.

点击“进入空调控制面板”，然后点击“刷新状态”。看到设备参数和最新时间即完成。开: Click Open aircon dashboard, then Refresh status. Device parameters and the latest query time confirm completion. Power and swing actions run only when you choose them, never automatically at sign-in.
设备身份校验通过，当前运行状态显示正常。: Device identity is verified and its current status is displayed.
已有 Token 无需抓包，按下面四步直接连接。: With an existing Token, follow these four steps to connect without capture.
打开“连接向导”，粘贴设备编号或选择二维码照片。官方 App 必须已登录并绑定同: Open Connection wizard and paste the device ID or choose a QR photo. You must already be signed in and paired to the same room in the official app. The QR code is not an account password.
按向导准备电脑，配置防火墙，在手机安装 WireGuard 并扫码。安装并信任: Follow the wizard to prepare the computer, configure the firewall, install WireGuard and scan the QR. Install and trust the mitmproxy certificate, then refresh the official app. Successful identity verification connects the dashboard.
面板可以开关空调、控制摆风。新建一个脚本，命名后拖入：开机 → 等待 → 关机。: The dashboard controls power and swing. Create and name a script, then connect: turn on → wait → turn off. Drag blocks to reorder them and edit number inputs to change the wait time.
上下拼接，按顺序执行；圆角输入槽接数字、文字或数据。: Connect blocks vertically to run in sequence. Value sockets accept numbers, text or data.
把动作放在内部。持续循环必须加停顿，避免不断请求接口。: Place actions inside. Add a wait to forever loops to avoid sending requests continuously.
放入比较条件，再把动作放进分支。条件不成立可以走“否则”。: Connect a condition and put actions inside the branch. Use else for the false case.
给数据起名字，例如“变量名”。先“设置变量”，再用“读取变量”。: Give data a name such as variable_name. Set the variable before reading it.
不发真实控制和消息，外部数据用示例值。循环最多演示 3 次；正式运行才连接真实服: No real controls or messages are sent. External data is simulated and loops run at most three times. Live execution connects real services.
使用星期、时刻和“当天只执行一次”积木，避免每分钟重复开关。当天去重在本次运行中: Use weekday, time and Once per day blocks to avoid repeated commands. Daily deduplication applies within one run; use persistent storage to retain the date across restarts.
主分支失败后执行错误分支。外部传感器失联时建议记录提示，不要假装读到正常温度。: Run the error branch if the main branch fails. Log a missing sensor instead of pretending its temperature is normal.
本地脚本需要程序保持打开，电脑不能睡眠。停止脚本不会自动关空调；对外请求可能需要: Local scripts require the app to remain open and the computer to stay awake. Stopping a script does not turn off the aircon. External requests may take several seconds to return.
Token 如含到期时间，会在面板显示。到期或提前撤销后，重新运行连接向导；程序: Token expiry is shown when available. Run the connection wizard again after expiry or revocation. Automatic Token refresh is not implemented.
mitm.it 打不开：先看电脑服务是否就绪、WireGuard 是否启用、热点: If mitm.it does not load, check the capture engine, WireGuard tunnel, hotspot IP and firewall. This configuration forwards IPv4 only.
证书页面正常但 App 报 TLS 错误：检查是否信任本次电脑生成的证书；某些版: If the certificate page loads but the app reports a TLS error, check that the certificate from this capture instance is fully trusted. Some app versions may perform additional certificate checks; decryption is not guaranteed.
房间不匹配会阻止控制。请核对完整二维码编号和 App 账号绑定，不能跳过校验。: Room mismatch blocks control. Check the complete QR device ID and account pairing. Identity verification cannot be skipped.
界面显示的是后端状态，不能确认压缩机转速、实际功率或能耗。不要把当前温度字段视为: The display shows backend status, not verified compressor speed, power or energy use. The current-temperature field is not an independent room thermometer.
事件、抗干扰与自定义代码: Events, manual override and custom code
在“事件 · 抗干扰”选择“等待变化”，来源选“疑似外部操作”，字段选电源或摆风: Under Events · Manual override, choose Wait for change, source Suspected external operation, and the power or swing field. Put Wait or Stop this script in the event branch so automation does not immediately override a manual change.
通过轮询观察，与本程序已发送的指令作短时匹配。无法确定操作者；两次查询之间发生又: Polling observations are correlated briefly with this app's commands. This cannot identify the operator, and changes that reverse between polls may be missed.
“稳定”要求观察值一段时间未改变；“持续成立”需要循环中反复检查；“回差”用不同: Stable checks that an observed value has not changed; debounce must be checked repeatedly in a loop. Hysteresis uses separate lower and upper thresholds; cooldown limits the frequency of a named action. Polling every 10–30 seconds is recommended.
在“逻辑 · 条件”中分别列出。所有模块支持任意嵌套，流程必须连接成一条主线。: These are separate blocks under Logic · Conditions. Conditions can be nested. Connect actions into one main flow.
顶部输入脚本名称，点“保存”。修改名称后保存即重命名；“另存一份”创建副本。控制: Enter a script name and click Save. Change the name and save to rename it; Save a copy creates a separate document. The dashboard runs saved versions.
HTTP 请求支持 GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE/HEAD: HTTP supports GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE/HEAD, JSON bodies and result paths. Use custom interface blocks for more complex signatures, protocols or algorithms.
拖入用户自定义模块或接口，点击该积木，再点“编辑选中模块代码”。Python 中: Add a custom block or interface, select it, and click Edit selected block code. Assign result to return a value; inputs corresponds to its input socket. You can also write a complete script in Python mode or open a .py file.
可识别的简单控制、等待、日志调用变成原生积木；复杂代码完整保留为自定义模块。代码: Recognized control, wait and log calls become native blocks. Complex code is retained in full as a custom block. Execution requires explicit trust; dry run checks syntax only. Importing a file does not execute it.
安装目录的“模块与代码指南.md”介绍完整分类、事件字段、SDK 和编写示例。当: See MODULES.md in the included source for categories, event fields, SDK and examples. No preset templates are bundled.
左侧“分支 · if / elif / else”有展开好的复合块，也可顺序拼接: Branches · if / elif / else contains compound blocks. You can also connect if → multiple elif → else. Only the first true branch runs. Else is optional; elif/else must immediately follow the preceding branch.
位于“流程 · 循环与异常”最前面，结束最近一层循环，继续执行循环后面的动作。: At the top of Flow · Loops and errors. It exits the nearest loop and continues after it.
跳过最近一层循环当前这轮的剩余动作，从下一轮继续；次数循环仍会计数，不影响外层循: Skip the rest of the nearest loop's current iteration and continue with the next. Counted loops still count the iteration; outer loops are unaffected.
正常完成次数、列表耗尽或条件变假时执行；break、错误、停止及演示截断不执行。: Runs after normal completion, list exhaustion or a false loop condition. It is skipped after break, error, cancellation or demo truncation. Preflight rejects break/continue outside loops.
拖入 switch，把 case/default 接进它的分支槽，case 内放: Add switch and connect case/default inside its branch socket. Put actions inside each case. Only the first match runs. Default must be last; no additional break is needed.
逻辑分类提供 XOR、XNOR、NAND、NOR、all/any、in/not: Logic includes XOR, XNOR, NAND, NOR, all/any, in/not in, type, null and variable-existence checks. Conditional values evaluate only the selected input.
pass 不做操作；raise 可进入错误分支；finally 用于正常、错误或: pass does nothing; raise enters an error branch; finally provides cleanup after normal completion, errors or loop jumps. Manual cancellation and runtime limits take priority, so cleanup is not guaranteed.
选中积木后，点击编辑器上方“编辑选中模块代码”。代码在本机 Python 进程执: Select a block, then click Edit selected block code above the editor. Code runs in a local Python process.
由 GitHub 托管 runner 执行，电脑关机后仍可定时恢复。导出包包含工: Run on GitHub-hosted runners and resume on schedule even while your computer is off. The export includes workflows and a headless runner, without personal Tokens, room IDs or connector credentials.

单次作业有时限，不能永久常驻；长期积木流程推荐断点模式。: Single jobs have a time limit and cannot stay running forever. Use checkpoint mode for long-running block flows.
云端提示记入执行结果，不会弹出已关闭电脑的界面。: Cloud notifications appear in run results, not on a computer that is switched off.
